place: Hornbill Festival Festival of Festivals Nagaland
text:
Hornbill Festival is an annual festival celebrated from 1 to 10 of December in the Northeastern Indian state of Nagaland. The festival represents all ethnic groups of Nagaland for which it is also called the Festival of Festivals.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Kohima is the capital city of Nagaland in North-Eastern India. Nagaland, also known as the "Switzerland of Asia", is a breath-takingly beautiful place.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
